IT Recruiter| Data, AI & Emerging Tech Hiring 🌏

FPT Software is looking for a Python Developer to join our growing engineering team and work on international projects with global clients.


What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in Python development
  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend development
  • Experience with Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, or Flask
  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Git, Linux, and Docker
  • Good problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Good English communication skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with Redis, Celery, Kafka, or message queues
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of frontend frameworks such as React or Angular
  • Experience with Kubernetes

Why join us

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale global projects
  • Exposure to international clients and experienced technical specialists
  • Competitive package and attractive career growth opportunities
  • FPT Care healthcare package
  • Company shuttle bus and attractive allowances
  • Modern working environment at F-Town Campus
  • Sports facilities, gym, cafeteria, and other employee benefits

Location

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
